title: How to Change Claude's Voice (5 Voices, Gender & Speed)
description: Change Claude's voice on mobile, web, and desktop: switch Buttery, Airy, Mellow, Glassy, or Rounded (female/male/British), speed, and Voice Mode tone.
h1: How to change Claude’s voice (all 5 voices, female/male options & tone).
dek: Exact iOS, Android, web, and desktop paths to switch between Buttery, Airy, Mellow, Glassy, and Rounded, pick speech speed, and keep spoken answers crisp.
lede: You can change Claude’s spoken audio voice across all five voice options (female-leaning, male-leaning, and British-accented) plus speech speed (Slow, Normal, Fast) on iOS, Android, web, and desktop—and separately tune how concise or direct Claude sounds out loud via Profile Personal Preferences.
answer: On iOS or Android, open Voice Mode (tap the waveform icon) and tap the bottom-left settings button—or go to Initials → Settings → Voice—to switch between Claude's 5 voices (Buttery, Airy, Mellow, Glassy, Rounded) and speech speed. On web or desktop, open Settings → Capabilities → Voice settings. To make Voice Mode give shorter spoken answers, add formatting rules in Settings → Profile → Personal preferences.

sections.h2: How to change Claude’s voice on mobile, web, and desktop.
sections.html:
Claude Voice Mode offers five English voice presets along with speech speed controls (Slow, Normal, Fast):

  1. On iOS & Android: Tap the Voice Mode waveform icon next to the composer, then tap the Settings button at the bottom-left of the voice screen (or tap your initials → Settings → Voice) to preview all five voices and adjust playback speed.
  2. On Web (claude.ai) & Claude Desktop: Click your profile initials (bottom-left) → Settings → Capabilities → Voice settings (or Settings → General on older layouts) to pick and save your voice.

sections.h2: Spoken audio voice vs. written Personal Preferences.
sections.html:
Changing a voice preset only changes pitch, cadence, and accent. Because Voice Mode reads Claude’s text output aloud, long markdown tables or multi-level bullet lists sound robotic when spoken. Pair your voice choice with a short Personal preferences block under Settings → Profile → Personal preferences (synced across mobile, web, and desktop), or open the full Claude personality & 7 setups guide.

# Voice-Mode friendly brevity - Answer in 2–4 natural spoken sentences first, then ask if I want detail. - Avoid Markdown tables, deeply nested bullet lists, and raw URLs unless I ask. - Lead with the takeaway cleanly without warm-up filler.

sections.h2: What measured testing shows about spoken-ready brevity.
sections.html: In our 60-reply controlled pilot (20 real tasks across default Claude, plain behavioral rules, and conversational framing), adding explicit concise rules lifted answer-first openings from 14/20 to 19/20, cut hedges per reply from 0.35 to 0.05, and dropped trailing follow-up questions from 0.90 to 0.25 without hurting task accuracy. Verify your settings in two fresh chats using the Instruction Test Bench.

faq.q: How do I change Claude's voice to female or male, or pick a British accent?
faq.a: Open Claude Voice Mode (tap the waveform icon) and tap the bottom-left settings button on mobile—or open Settings → Capabilities → Voice settings on web or desktop. Pick Buttery or Airy for female-leaning voices, Mellow for a calm male-leaning voice, Glassy for bright articulation, or Rounded for a British-accented cadence.

faq.q: How do I change Claude's voice on the iPhone or Android app?
faq.a: Tap the Voice Mode waveform icon in the mobile composer and open its bottom-left settings icon, or tap your initials → Settings → Voice to pick Buttery, Airy, Mellow, Glassy, or Rounded and choose Slow, Normal, or Fast playback speed.

faq.q: Do my Claude Personal Preferences affect Voice Mode replies?
faq.a: Yes. Personal Preferences sync across claude.ai web, desktop, and mobile apps. Keeping replies under 2–4 sentences with no Markdown tables makes Voice Mode conversations sound much more natural.
